# MedBridge

> International medical shadowing and clinical observership program at Astghik Medical Center, a JCI-accredited, ISO 9001:2015 certified multidisciplinary hospital in Yerevan, Armenia. One, two or three weeks. Not a degree program.

## Key facts

- Hospital: Astghik Medical Center, Yerevan (official site: https://mcastghik.com/). More than 30 departments, 15 operating rooms. JCI accreditation effective 31 May 2025 to 30 May 2028; ISO 9001:2015 by TÜV Rheinland, valid to 26 Aug 2027.
- Program: 24 clinical specialties; observation of up to 5 surgeries daily, Monday to Friday, up to 40 hours a week; clinical rounds, post-operative discussions, OR protocols. Conducted in English.
- Who: medical students years 1–6, pre-med students (observational only), international healthcare trainees, residents and young physicians. Minimum age 18 (16–17 only with written parental consent, observational programs only). Supervised hands-on exposure possible for advanced participants, subject to hospital approval and Armenian regulations.
- When: arrival every Saturday, year-round; rotation starts the following Monday. Durations of 1, 2 or 3 weeks; longer on request.
- Price (from, USD, per participant): $1,500 for 1 week, $3,800 for 2 weeks, $4,500 for 3 weeks. 10% discount for groups of 3+. Applying is free; itemised quote valid 14 days.
- Included: clinical program, accommodation near the hospital, airport transfers, pre-arrival health-screening review, cultural excursions, certificate of completion, recommendation letter, visa assistance and invitation letter.
- Not included: flights, mandatory travel and medical insurance, bank transfer fees, pre-arrival laboratory tests.
- Health documents before arrival (PDF, dated within 6 months, due 14 days before arrival): HIV 1/2 Ag/Ab, HBsAg, Anti-HBs (≥10 mIU/mL), Anti-HBc total, Anti-HCV, syphilis screen. Proof of routine immunisations and TB screening where indicated.
- Refunds: full refund 30+ days before start; 50% between 14 and 29 days; none within 14 days except where required by law; one free reschedule with 14 days' notice; full refund if an Armenian visa is refused.
- Visa: citizens of the EU, UK, US, Canada, Australia and many other countries enter Armenia visa-free for up to 180 days in any 365-day period.
- Contact: info@medbridge.am, +374 77 33 83 33, WhatsApp on the same number. MedBridge office: 13 Khanjyan str., Yerevan, Armenia. Program venue: Astghik Medical Center, Yerevan.
